description: Controlling resources, denying necessities, tracking spending, withholding or hiding jointly earned money, lying about assets, refusing access to an account, changing passwords, hiding documents.
Withholding passports, ID, insurance papers or employment contracts makes it difficult to apply for jobs, register for courses or claim entitlements - the identity itself held as security.
energy_note: Her passport, in his drawer, for six years.

description: 'It's easier if it all comes into mine, then I do the transfers.' It is easier. After four months the transfers arrive late. After a year she asks for the login and he is hurt that she does not trust him.
energy_note: Efficient, then late, then his feelings are the subject.

aspect: It is common and not widely recognised as abuse
description: Lifetime prevalence among ever-partnered women runs 11-15% in general populations and 76-99% among those seeking services for intimate partner violence.
energy_note: Three quarters and up, among those already seeking help.
